entities.summary: Maxim Krivonozhkin is a Russian former professional ice hockey forward who most recently played for HC Sibir Novosibirsk of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He is currently the assistant coach for Neftekhimik Nizhnekamsk of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL).
